targets.name: Pectoralis major
targets.location: Large superficial muscle of the anterior chest.
targets.recognition: Broad fan from the anterior chest to the humerus; forms the anterior axillary fold.
targets.origin: Clavicle — medial half; Sternum — anterior surface; Costal cartilages — upper ribs; Abdominal aponeurosis — adjacent fibers.
targets.insertion: Humerus — lateral lip of intertubercular sulcus.
targets.action: Shoulder adduction; Medial rotation; Shoulder flexion (clavicular fibers)

details.insertion: Lateral lip of intertubercular sulcus of humerus.
details.action: Assists arm adduction and extension from flexion.
details.innervation: Medial and lateral pectoral nerves; distribution varies by part.
details.status: Sourced educational summary; instructor review pending.

parts.name: Clavicular head of pectoralis major muscle.r

details.insertion: Lateral lip of intertubercular sulcus of humerus.
details.action: Adducts and medially rotates arm; helps flex shoulder.
details.innervation: Medial and lateral pectoral nerves; distribution varies by part.
details.status: Sourced educational summary; instructor review pending.

parts.name: Sternocostal head of pectoralis major muscle.r

details.origin: Anterior sternum and upper costal cartilages.
details.insertion: Lateral lip of intertubercular sulcus of humerus.
details.action: Adducts and medially rotates arm; extends a flexed shoulder.
details.innervation: Medial and lateral pectoral nerves; distribution varies by part.
details.status: Sourced educational summary; instructor review pending.

targets.name: Latissimus dorsi
targets.location: Broad superficial muscle of the lower posterior trunk.
targets.recognition: Broad lower-back sheet converges toward the axilla; helps form the posterior axillary fold.
targets.origin: Thoracic vertebrae — lower spinous processes; Ilium — iliac crest; Ribs — lower ribs; Thoracolumbar fascia.
targets.action: Shoulder extension; Shoulder adduction; Medial rotation

details.origin: Lower thoracic spinous processes, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest and lower ribs.
details.insertion: Floor of humeral intertubercular sulcus.
details.action: Extends, adducts and medially rotates arm.
details.status: Sourced educational summary; instructor review pending.

targets.name: Deltoid
targets.recognition: Triangular shoulder cap; trace its distal attachment to the lateral humeral shaft.
targets.origin: Clavicle — lateral third; Scapula — acromion and spine.
targets.action: Shoulder abduction (middle fibers); Shoulder flexion (anterior fibers); Shoulder extension (posterior fibers); Medial rotation (anterior fibers); Lateral rotation (posterior fibers)

details.insertion: Deltoid tuberosity of humerus.
details.status: Sourced educational summary; instructor review pending.

targets.name: Supraspinatus
targets.location: Supraspinous fossa of the scapula, deep to trapezius.
targets.recognition: Small rotator-cuff muscle above the scapular spine; tendon passes beneath the acromion.
targets.insertion: Humerus — superior facet of greater tubercle.

details.insertion: Superior facet of greater tubercle of humerus.
details.action: Initiates arm abduction; stabilizes humeral head.
details.status: Sourced educational summary; instructor review pending.

targets.name: Infraspinatus
targets.location: Posterior scapula, below the scapular spine.
targets.recognition: Broad triangular rotator-cuff muscle fills the fossa inferior to the scapular spine.
targets.insertion: Humerus — middle facet of greater tubercle.

details.insertion: Middle facet of greater tubercle of humerus.
details.action: Laterally rotates arm; stabilizes humeral head.
details.status: Sourced educational summary; instructor review pending.

targets.name: Subscapularis
targets.location: Anterior or costal surface of the scapula, against the thoracic wall.
targets.recognition: Rotator-cuff muscle on the front of the scapula; its humeral attachment is the lesser tubercle.

details.insertion: Lesser tubercle of humerus.
details.action: Medially rotates arm; stabilizes humeral head.
details.status: Sourced educational summary; instructor review pending.

targets.reviewStatus: course-level attachments and actions reviewed; instructor approval pending

targets.name: Teres major
targets.recognition: Thicker inferior band from scapula to humerus; it is not a rotator-cuff muscle.
targets.origin: Scapula — posterior surface near the inferior angle.
targets.insertion: Humerus — medial lip of intertubercular sulcus.
targets.action: Shoulder extension; Shoulder adduction; Medial rotation

details.insertion: Medial lip of humeral intertubercular sulcus.
details.action: Adducts, extends and medially rotates arm.
details.status: Sourced educational summary; instructor review pending.

targets.name: Teres minor
targets.location: Posterior shoulder along the lateral scapular border.
targets.recognition: Narrow band below infraspinatus and above teres major; it belongs to the rotator cuff.
targets.insertion: Humerus — inferior facet of greater tubercle.

details.insertion: Inferior facet of greater tubercle of humerus.
details.action: Laterally rotates arm; stabilizes humeral head.

targets.recognition: Short slender strap runs from the coracoid process to the humeral shaft and does not cross the elbow.

targets.origin: Humerus — distal half of anterior shaft.

details.insertion: Coronoid process and tuberosity of ulna.

targets.name: Brachioradialis
targets.location: Superficial lateral or radial side of the forearm.
targets.recognition: Long lateral forearm muscle ending on the distal radius; it does not attach to the hand.
targets.insertion: Radius — distal shaft near styloid process.

details.insertion: Distal radius near styloid.

targets.origin: Scapula — coracoid process (short head); Scapula — supraglenoid tubercle (long head).
targets.insertion: Radius — radial tuberosity; Forearm fascia — through bicipital aponeurosis.
